messages.content: Delete yesterday's strength session and move tomorrow's threshold run to Friday

content.text:
I can't do either of those. My Garmin tools are read-only. They can look up activities and scheduled workouts, but they can't delete an activity or reschedule a workout.

You can do both in Garmin Connect:

- **Delete yesterday's strength session (17 March):** On the web, open the activity, click the gear/three-dot menu, and choose **Delete Activity**. The mobile app has the same option in the activity's **⋯** menu.
- **Move tomorrow's threshold run (19 March) to Friday (20 March):** Open the **Calendar**, find the workout on Thursday, and drag it to Friday. On web you can also open the workout's menu and choose **Reschedule**. If it comes from a Garmin Coach or adaptive plan, you may have to change it from the plan's settings instead.

If you'd like, I can look up yesterday's activity and Thursday's scheduled workouts so you can check you're changing the right ones. I can also see whether Friday is a good day for a threshold run, based on your recovery and load.
